title: David's Census and God's Punishment
description: David orders Joab to count the people of Israel and Judah, which provokes the Lord's anger. After repenting of his sin, David is given a choice among three punishments through the prophet Gad. He chooses to fall into the Lord's hands, and a plague kills seventy thousand in Israel until the Lord relents and stops the angel at Araunah's threshing floor. David prays that the punishment should instead fall on him.
